art_direction: 瓷白湖青 · 清冷小猫: 冷白底，湖青细长半眯眼与极小平嘴，眼线柔和上扬。
composition_variation: A smooth cool porcelain-white field, not cream. Luminous lagoon-cyan irises in long slender almond-shaped cat eyes. Broad rounded black pupils, fine graceful sweeping black upper lids with tapered ends. The upper lids gently cut across the irises, making a relaxed half-lidded gaze with friendly intelligence, not anger. A very slight head tilt, both eyes nearly the same size and on one coherent tilted line. Each eye has one small softly tapered white reflection. Two extremely small pale lavender-gray eyebrow dabs above the eyes add warmth; one tiny black horizontal mouth below the central gap. The overall impression is beautiful, cool, sweet and a little proud. Avoid full round colored rings, heavy blocky eyelids, dirty grain, yellow tint.
